prompt:
A tower crane on a construction site lifts a pallet of bricks of mass 850 kg vertically from ground level to the top of a building at a constant speed in a time of 32.0 s. The vertical height gained is 28.0 m.
(a) Calculate the gain in gravitational potential energy of the bricks. [2]
(b) Calculate the minimum useful power output of the crane motor during the lift. [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: Uses Delta E_p = mg Delta h with m = 850 kg, g = 9.81 m s^-2, Delta h = 28.0 m.
Calculates Delta E_p = 2.33 * 10^5 J (or 233 kJ, accept 233.5 kJ).
Calculates useful power output P = Delta E_p / t = 233478 / 32.0 = 7.30 * 10^3 W (or 7.30 kW).

hints: In part (a), use Delta E_p = mg Delta h.
In part (b), recall that power is the rate of work done or energy transferred: P = Delta E_p / t.
solution:
(a) Delta E_p = mg Delta h = 850 kg * 9.81 m s^-2 * 28.0 m = 233 478 J = 2.33 * 10^5 J (or 233 kJ).
(b) Useful power output P = Delta E_p / t = 233 478 J / 32.0 s = 7296 W = 7.30 * 10^3 W (or 7.30 kW).
teacher_walkthrough: Part (a): Award C1 for formula and substitution 850 * 9.81 * 28.0. Award A1 for 2.33 * 10^5 J.
Part (b): Relate power to rate of energy transferred: P = W / t. 233 478 / 32.0 = 7.30 * 10^3 W. Award A1.
Check units and ensure correct 3 significant figures.
